title: Questor sidecar lifecycle status (process-scoped, not per-run)
description: Additive-only process-level state emitted by the desktop shell (§6-5). Distinct from the per-run event envelope: it carries no run_id. Producer = Rust shell (on_crash_detect); consumer = UI. Strict whitelist (additionalProperties:false); detail is bounded and never carries crash traces/secrets (C20).

generation.description: Shell Fence generation; increments on crash-restart so the UI can drop stale status.

detail.description: Bounded short attribution; never raw traceback or secrets (C20).
